f-modern.label: Female · modern
f-modern.text: a high school girl with long silver hair and amber eyes, wearing a navy sailor uniform with a red neckerchief, standing on a school rooftop at sunset, one hand resting on the chain-link fence, looking back over her shoulder with a soft smile, wind lifting her hair, city skyline and glowing orange clouds behind her

m-modern.label: Male · modern
m-modern.text: a high school boy with messy black hair and sharp green eyes, wearing an unbuttoned black gakuran uniform over a white shirt, standing on a school rooftop at sunset with his hands in his pockets, leaning back against the chain-link fence, confident half-smile, wind tousling his hair, city skyline and glowing orange clouds behind him

f-scifi.label: Female · sci-fi space
f-scifi.text: a young woman starship pilot with short teal hair and violet eyes, wearing a fitted white and orange flight suit with mission patches, holding her helmet under one arm, standing on the bridge of a starship in front of a huge panoramic window showing a ringed gas giant and a colorful nebula, holographic consoles glowing around her, calm determined expression

m-scifi.label: Male · sci-fi space
m-scifi.text: a rugged male bounty hunter with a scar across his cheek and slicked-back dark hair, wearing a long dark coat over light armor plating, holding a heavy blaster pistol at his side, standing on a spaceport landing pad at night, starships lifting off overhead, neon signs and floodlights cutting through the haze, wary sidelong glance

f-fantasy.label: Female · D&D fantasy
f-fantasy.text: a young elf ranger woman with long braided auburn hair, pointed ears and green eyes, wearing leather armor and a hooded green cloak, holding a longbow with an arrow nocked, standing among ancient moss-covered stone ruins in a deep forest, shafts of golden light falling through the canopy, alert focused expression

m-fantasy.label: Male · D&D fantasy
m-fantasy.text: a young male paladin with short blond hair and blue eyes, wearing battered steel plate armor and a blue tabard with a silver sun emblem, both hands resting on the pommel of a greatsword planted point-down in front of him, standing in a torchlit stone dungeon hall with pillars and drifting dust, resolute expression
